about.title: Game da Ita
about.bio:
Fehintola Onabanjo mai hidimar waƙar bishara da ta ƙarfafa gwiwa ce a harshen Yarbanci, wadda sautinta ke haɗa waƙoƙin gargajiya na Yarbawa, Highlife, Alujo da Gospel Reggae. Ta fara aikinta na waƙa a shekarar 2016 da Ara Edide, kuma tun daga lokacin ta fitar da kundaye huɗu da waƙoƙi da dama, waɗanda ake sauraro a faɗin duniya.

A matsayinta na shugabar ƙungiyar Favoured Music Band, Fehintola (JP) na gabatar da wasanni kai tsaye masu cike da kuzari, waɗanda suka shafi bangaskiya, juriya da al'adun Afirka. Waƙoƙinta na magana da waɗanda suka gaji, masu bege da masu godiya — tana tunatar da mu cewa mu masu tagomashi ne.
about.noAwards: Za a jera kyaututtuka a nan.
about.quote: Waƙa ita ce hidimata. Waƙa, saƙonni da shaidu ko'ina — harshe ne na duniya baki ɗaya.
